authority: Executable predicate authority for every ARG-V5-RUNTIME-BINDINGS.csv row owned by plugin, plugin_unlit, or plugin_finale. A runtime implementation may be stricter for safety but may not weaken, auto-complete, or substitute a generic interaction for these predicates.

coordinate_convention.origin: the site anchor in DEEP-HOLD-FIXTURE-MANIFEST.csv or the registered external site anchor
coordinate_convention.front: the fixture expected_front direction toward its documented player standing cell
coordinate_convention.rotation: Bukkit ItemFrame Rotation ordinal 0..7; quarter turns are 0,2,4,6

minecraft_local_primary.local_commit: atomic replace of the local V5 progress record before rewards, gates, or theater; protected world state is a readback, not the only record
minecraft_local_primary.supabase: asynchronous idempotent mirror; outage or stale remote state never rolls back a locally committed physical solve
minecraft_local_primary.reconcile: local completion wins for plugin-owned flags; a remote true may hydrate local state only after prerequisite and manifest-version validation

finale_local_primary.local_commit: fsync temporary file and atomic replace before any finale presentation, kick, save, or shutdown
finale_local_primary.supabase: asynchronous coda mirror after the local commit; never a condition for theater
finale_local_primary.reconcile: COMMITTED or CODA local state is terminal and cannot be reset by remote state

global_rules.protection: Players cannot break, place, rotate, extract, or insert blocks/items except components explicitly exposed by the active handler.
global_rules.item_identity: Every required evidence or artifact item must match material and all listed PDC pairs. Display name or vanilla material alone never satisfies a predicate.
global_rules.atomicity: A completion flag, branch value, inventory escrow, and reward delivery are one serialized transaction. On any persistence failure the world is restored to its pre-attempt state.
global_rules.wrong_items: A rejected item is returned to the same inventory slot when possible, then player inventory, then protected recovery escrow; it is never deleted or dropped into an unprotected world cell.
global_rules.recovery: Recovery scans online inventories, ender chests, protected fixture inventories, and recovery escrow before reissuing any unique artifact.
global_rules.no_touch_completion: No predicate may complete merely because a player entered a radius, clicked an arbitrary block, or touched the named site. Every completion below requires all enumerated evidence, state, answer, route, or quorum conditions.
global_rules.answer_normalization: Answer-sign text is Unicode NFKC, color/control stripped, trimmed, uppercased with Locale.ROOT, punctuation converted to spaces, and internal whitespace collapsed. Only explicit accepted values below pass.
global_rules.prerequisites: All listed flags must be true before inputs are accepted. A locked interaction reports the first missing case/node without consuming or changing anything.

conduct_verdict.source: only durable first-ballot telemetry from WR05 and RP03; retired customs, bowing, compliance, and hidden morality scores are forbidden inputs
conduct_verdict.first_ballot: the first durable vote window snapshot, closed when its initial visible roster all votes, its 45-second window ends, or a disconnect resnapshot becomes necessary; it is recorded before any tiebreak/revote and may be valid but incomplete
precedence: DIVIDED when either first ballot has first_ballot_distinct_choices > 1 or first_ballot_tied=true
UNANIMOUS when both first ballots have cast_count == eligible_count, distinct_choices == 1, and the maximum visible roster is > 1
PERSISTENT otherwise, including an incomplete first ballot followed by a valid disconnect resnapshot or later resolution round
conduct_verdict.totality: RP03 cannot commit without valid WR05 and RP03 first-ballot telemetry plus eventual resolved branches. For every valid committed pair exactly one precedence branch applies; null/unknown is rejected, not defaulted.
